name: two nodes, and which one is quicker for whom
why: The capture features are measured from whichever of a faction's units is nearest the node -- not from the unit being decided for -- and the two nodes here are nearest to different units of the same side. A side measuring from the wrong unit, or averaging terrain along a route it chose rather than the fixed one, disagrees on the second node and not the first. The fourth case is the one that pins the route order itself: it is the only node on this board that is reached by moving on both axes through ground that differs, so swapping the two loops changes its answer and nothing else's -- which is how a review found the first three could not tell the orders apart.

cases.why: nearest is the unit at (2,3); the route goes along x first and crosses the rough ground
the other node of the same side is nearest a different unit, and the walk is all open ground
the same node for the other side: closer, outnumbered, and quicker than both
